newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Stet denies deal with AT&T.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Stet denies deal with AT&T.

text.p: Italian state telecommunications holding company Stet denied Italian press reports of an imminent broad-based alliance in the sector with the U.S. AT&T Corp.
A Stet spokesman had no specific comment to make on the reports, adding that the group was in continuous contact with several foreign telecoms groups.
The press reports also carried denials of an accord by an AT&T spokeswoman.

Financial daily Il Sole 24 Ore said a possible strategic alliance between Stet and AT&T could either involve Stet entering the Unisource consortium, which Spain's Telefonica would leave, or the two groups could create a new consortium to take part jointly in the privatisation of Brazil's Telebras state-owned telephone company.
Il Sole also speculated that Stet and AT&T had examined the possibility of a share swap or even AT&T taking a stake in Stet.

Stet and its telephone operator unit Telecom Italia are due to hold board meetings on Friday which will discuss the planned fusion of Telecom into Stet by June ahead of the privatisation of the new group planned by autumn.
